original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.

allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.

actual_scope: Independent exact replay of idle-axis redistribution on all 112 T740 port recipes for owner replica zero: every eligible one-axis and paired transfer among children (8,10,12,13); the source-pinned PR3184 replica-0/port-0 star; the same-centre-star isolation argument; an optional rank-only CP-SAT assignment optimum; and an optional exact-coordinate CP-SAT feasibility screen. The latter enumerates all 256 Z4 phase deltas at each of 73 coordinate characters, then asks whether any rank-changing arbitrary assignment of the 192 residual tokens can preserve those matrices, with hosted axes fixed, final bases orthonormal and rank cap 51.
scope_change_reason: PR3187 supplies an exact physical counterexample to PR3184’s first committed star move. The single-transfer census extends this to the same-centre star class. The first OR-Tools model nominated rank-only optima but did not constrain operator equality. A later OR-Tools screen inserts exact equality at all 73 coordinate characters into a broader assignment relaxation before asking about rank changes. Discussion #2612 now has a distinct active claim about paid phase-child repairs; this package is scoped to the no-repair assignment class and does not duplicate the repair-cost analysis. The user explicitly favored OR-Tools for optimization.
bottleneck_link: A lower rank moment helps only if the exact hosted eight-stream operator is preserved. Every eligible one-axis transfer fails; the single-axis census isolates same-centre stars. For the broader four-child owner-0 assignment relaxation, the exact-coordinate CP-SAT screen finds no rank-changing assignment even before the per-axis translation gates are imposed. No result changes a complete supplier moment, κ, admission or the selected frontier.
stop_rule: Authenticate the complete T740 fill and PR3184 star artifact; verify the positive baseline controls; enumerate single and paired transfers; replay the pinned star; screen the rank-only optimum; then compute all 73 exact coordinate phase tables per port and solve the rank-change CP-SAT feasibility model across all 112 ports. Stop this owner-replica-zero four-child slice after its registered replay and 112 infeasibility receipts. Do not generalize to another owner, child/time pair, schedule or supplier.
evidence: verify.py authenticates the PR3148 T740 payload SHA256 8f4d6965…e00 and the complete PR3184 STAR-MOVES payload from head 6faefe19f592220c16722a6682c22c8fbccd4bb4. It checks the baseline on 147 modes for port 0 plus the zero-character identity for all ports; all 21,504 eligible single-axis candidates and 5,376 paired candidates change the exact Gaussian-integer stream matrix at their own Fourier character. The moved axes in a same-centre star are a subset of one orthonormal donor basis, so any nonempty same-centre star is isolated by one rejected single move on each audited owner-0 recipe. The actual PR3184 replica-0/port-0 star sends [16,32,64] from child 10 to 12 and [128,256,4096] from 10 to 13; at character 16 its full overlay equals the isolated single move and differs from baseline in three entries. Optional OR-Tools 9.11.4210 rank-only search solves 112 models to [51,51,51,39] from [48,48,48,48], but its representative fails exact replay. A second optional OR-Tools screen independently constructs exact phase-delta tables by replaying all 256 delta vectors at each of 73 coordinate characters. For every character of every one of the 112 ports, only delta (0,0,0,0) preserves the operator (table SHA256 ed9ef60a17efb46b44a064986acf28935c7ab07a46ddc8007dc802bbc8200a83). Under the broader arbitrary-token assignment model with fixed hosted axes, orthonormal final bases and rank cap 51, CP-SAT proves INFEASIBLE for any rank-changing assignment in all 112 ports. This is a finite-coordinate necessary-condition screen, not a full symbolic all-character proof. No new κ or selected-frontier change.
